records.name: Kids on 12th
records.notes: The site describes Kids on 12th School, an enrollment based early education school at 1112 Chestnut St (Philadelphia 19107) with preschool, grades K to 3, after-school pick up and summer camp for children ages 2 to 11. Families enroll through tours and registration. No volunteer, member or open community program is shown, so it is treated as a school rather than a community group. The site address does not match the IRS address in the batch (1323 Titan St).

records.name: Kiwanis Club (South Philadelphia)
records.summary: A local club in the Kiwanis service network in South Philadelphia. I could not reach its website because the site blocked my visit, and I found no dated news, so meeting times and how to join are not yet known.
records.notes: Club website k19067.site.kiwanis.org returned HTTP 403, so it is listed under blocked. ProPublica lists the filer as Kiwanis International Inc, tagged as the South Philadelphia Kiwanis club (number K19061), but the batch website carries club number 19067. The club number needs a manual check. One web search for South Philadelphia Kiwanis found no club page. Audience and meeting details are not established, so audience.open_to is left out and the record will be held back until verified. The display name is a working name, not confirmed on the club's own site.

records.name: La Raza for Liberation
records.summary: A Philadelphia charity that the IRS lists under civil rights and advocacy work. I could not reach a website for it, and the newest tax filing I found is from 2020, so it may not be active now.
records.notes: Both larazaforliberation.org and www.larazaforliberation.org fail to resolve (DNS error), so no contacts are recorded. Status is dormant only because the newest dated record I found is a tax filing made in November 2020 (tax year 2019). No event, post or news item was found. The IRS category is civil rights, social action and advocacy, and racial_equity is the closest tag. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out.

records.name: Lectionary Company
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit that the IRS lists as a religion related media and communications group. I could not reach a website or find any public events, so what it makes and how to take part are not yet known.
records.notes: The batch website thelectionarycompany.org fails to resolve (DNS error), with or without www. The guess lectionarycompany.org also fails. ProPublica lists 501(c)(3) status from February 2016, with no financial data and no website. The name and IRS label point to religious or scripture material, but this is not confirmed; scripture_study is the closest tag and should be checked. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out.

records.name: Legendary Performances
records.summary: I could not find a working website, a clear name match, or any public activity for this group, so what it offers and how to take part are not yet known.
records.notes: The batch website legendaryperfprmances.org (likely a misspelling) and the corrected legendaryperformances.org both fail to resolve (DNS error). ProPublica's page for this EIN shows only an unknown organization with a 2002 filing, so it cannot confirm the name or purpose, and no source URL is recorded. Both WebSearch calls went to other groups, so this group got no name search. No categories, interests or audience are set because the group type is not established. The record will be held back until a name search is run by hand.

records.name: LGBT Heart
records.summary: A group whose IRS legal name points to LGBT health education and research. I could not reach a website, and my one search for LGBT Heart found no current listing under that name, so its programs and how to take part are not yet known.
records.notes: Both www.lgbtheart.org and lgbtheart.org fail to resolve (DNS error). The ProPublica page for this EIN returned HTTP 404, so there is no public source page to cite and the record has no sources, which holds it back. The legal name is Lesbian Gay Bisexual Transgender Health Education Research TR Inc, with an alternate name LGBT Heart in the batch. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out. The LGBT search results were general directories and mention William Way and Philly Pride 365 (see leads_only), not this group.

records.name: Little Loves Orphanage
records.notes: The group's own site describes an orphanage project in India with a girls' home and a boys' home, and a partner project in Andhra Pradesh. No Philadelphia meetings, programs or volunteer roles appear on the site. The IRS address on file is in Philadelphia, but the site shows no local activity. The site's most recent dated item is a 2023 video recap.

records.name: Marathon Acts
records.summary: A Philadelphia arts and culture group that received tax exempt status in 2022. Its website returned a page not found error for me, and I found no dated events, classes or public contact, so what it offers is not yet known.
records.notes: The batch website www.marathonacts.com and marathonacts.com both returned HTTP 404, which means the server answered but the page is missing. ProPublica gives a multipurpose arts and culture label, not specifically theater, so community_theater is the closest tag and is a guess to check. Audience and a way in are not established, so audience.open_to is left out and the record will be held back until verified.

records.name: Mazeppa Productions
records.summary: A Philadelphia theater nonprofit that received tax exempt status in 2013. I found no working website, shows or public contact, and the newest tax year I could see is 2011, so it may not be active.
records.notes: The batch website mazeppa.com is a personal promotional site for a comedy character from a Tulsa television show. It is not this group's site, so it is not recorded as a contact. The IRS listing shows only the tax year ending December 2011 with no filing date, so last_sign_of_life uses that year end. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out.

records.name: Military Assistance Project
records.summary: A Philadelphia charity that the IRS lists under legal related services. The website on file is a parked page, and the newest tax filing I found is from 2018, so it may not be active. What it offers is not confirmed.
records.notes: The batch website militaryassistanceproject.org shows a parked page that says the domain may be for sale, so it is not recorded as a contact. ProPublica shows 501(c)(3) status from March 2014 and the newest filing for tax year 2017, filed November 14, 2018. The legal services label is an IRS category, not a stated purpose, and the closest tag should be checked. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out.

records.name: Mobilized Construction Foundation
records.summary: A Philadelphia charity that the IRS lists under community improvement work. Its website blocked my visit and I found no dated activity, so what it builds or offers is not yet known.
records.notes: The website mobilizedconstruction.com returned HTTP 403, so it is listed under blocked and not read. ProPublica shows 501(c)(3) status from October 2016 with no financial data. The community improvement label is an IRS category, not a stated purpose. The batch address is a PO Box in 19110. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out.

records.name: Museum Council of Philadelphia
records.summary: A membership network for people who work in and support Philadelphia museums. Members get a job bank, mentoring, small grants and events, and they can join committees or the board.
records.what_you_do: Apply for the mentoring program, join a committee or the board, write guest posts for the site, or help host behind the scenes museum events.

first_step.how: Join or renew through the membership page at philamuseumcouncil.org, or email info@philamuseumcouncil.org to ask about upcoming events.
first_step.basis: Joining runs through a membership page, and the site does not show dues or an application. The events page did not list specific events when I checked, so the way in for non members is unclear.

records.notes: Newest dated items on the site: an August 8, 2026 statement, and a mentorship application open until November 18, 2026. The IRS address (720 Arch St) is not shown on the site, so no location is recorded. The newsletter sign up notice says storage is not set up yet. Open to members per the membership pages.

records.name: NALS of Philadelphia
records.summary: A legal secretaries association that the IRS data lists at a Philadelphia address. The tax record under this number belongs to a national group based in Indianapolis, and I could not reach a local website, so whether a Philadelphia group meets here is not yet known.
records.notes: The website nalsofphiladelphia.org does not resolve (DNS error), with or without www. ProPublica shows EIN 731457279 as the National Association of Legal Secretaries Inc in Indianapolis (501(c)(6), latest filing for the year ending April 2025), not a Philadelphia group. The batch address (1735 Market Street, 19103) comes from the 990-N list and could not be matched to a local group. The display name is the website name, not confirmed. Needs a manual check (a local chapter, a second EIN, or a closed chapter) before it goes live. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out.

records.name: NAAAP Philadelphia
records.summary: The Philadelphia chapter of a national group for Asian American professionals. It holds career, leadership and networking events, and members can volunteer for community service.
records.what_you_do: Go to career and networking events on the chapter calendar, join the volunteer team, or help with community service projects.

first_step.how: Use the Join link on naaapphila.org to see membership options, or email NAAAPPHILA@gmail.com to ask about the next networking event.
first_step.basis: The chapter site has a public join link and public events, and it says some events are members only. No fee or application is shown on the site.

records.notes: IRS legal name: National Association Of Asian American Professionals-Philadelphia. The IRS mailing address is in Bensalem, PA, which is not a meeting place, so no location is recorded. The chapter site naaapphila.org was found on the national chapter list, because phl.naaap.org returned HTTP 503 on three tries. Last dated item: a December 8, 2025 board news post. Two upcoming events (October 29 and November 11) show no year on the page, so they are not used as evidence.

records.name: National Association of Minority Contractors, Philadelphia Chapter
records.summary: A Philadelphia chapter of a national association for minority contractors, which the IRS registered as a charity in 2018. I could not reach a website or find any dated activity, so what the chapter offers and how to join are not yet known.
records.notes: The website namcphiladelphia.org does not resolve (DNS error), with or without www. ProPublica lists 501(c)(3) status from June 2018 with no financial data. Its employment and job training label is an IRS category, not a stated purpose. ProPublica notes the group is not on the IRS's most recent exempt list, so its current status needs checking. Audience is not established, so audience.open_to is left out.

notes: The batch file holds 15 groups, not 10, and all 15 are covered. Verdicts: publish 13, not_a_group 1, out_of_area 1, hide 0. Searches: both WebSearch calls used (South Philadelphia Kiwanis: no club page found; LGBT Heart: no current listing found). Fetches: 40 calls, including errors. Sites that did not resolve (DNS error with and without www): larazaforliberation.org, thelectionarycompany.org, legendaryperfprmances.org (typo), legendaryperformances.org, lectionarycompany.org, lgbtheart.org, nalsofphiladelphia.org, namcphiladelphia.org. Marathon Acts site returned 404 on both forms. The Mazeppa Productions site on file is an unrelated personal site and was not used. The Military Assistance Project site is a parked page. ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer was used for IRS facts where the group's own site was dead, blocked or parked. Records without audience.open_to (Kiwanis, La Raza, Lectionary, Legendary, Marathon Acts, Mazeppa, Military Assistance, Mobilized, NALS, NAMC) are held back on purpose until checked. LGBT Heart has no source URL (its ProPublica page returned 404), so it is held back too. No WebSearch was left for Legendary Performances, Marathon Acts, Lectionary Company, La Raza, NALS, NAMC or Mobilized. The best next checks: the Kiwanis club number, NALS Philadelphia, Legendary Performances and LGBT Heart. Rate limiting was not seen.
